后量子验证者密钥注册表
summary: Pierre 与 winderica 把 Tornado Cash 移植到后量子二元域 SNARK Flock，SHA-256 上深度 32 的提款证明不到 30 毫秒，并给出离散对数被攻破后现有池子也能存活的恢复协议。Vitalik 认为预编译和 EVM 都不是放大部分密码学支持的地方，因为数据都得进区块 calldata。EIP-8288 提议把递归 STARK 移进执行负载，tcoratger 提交后量子验证者密钥注册表。

items.title: ethresear.ch：更快、可聚合、抗量子的隐私池
items.note: 17:59（Pierre，与 winderica 合作）。Tornado Cash 这类池子靠 Pedersen 承诺和 Groth16 证明，都依赖离散对数难题。作者把它移植到 Flock（后量子二元域 SNARK），基于 SHA-256 的深度 32 提款证明不到 30 毫秒，并描述一个简单的恢复协议：只要钱包从种子派生 note 秘密，现有池子在离散对数被攻破后也能存活。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: faster, aggregatable and quantum-safe privacy pools
items.note_en: 17:59 (Pierre, with winderica). Pools like Tornado Cash rely on Pedersen commitments and Groth16 proofs, both resting on the hardness of discrete log. The authors port it to Flock, a post-quantum binary-field SNARK, proving a depth-32 withdrawal over SHA-256 in under 30 ms, and describe a simple recovery protocol: as long as wallets derive note secrets from a seed, existing pools can survive a discrete log break.

items.title: Vitalik：预编译和 EVM 都不是放大部分密码学支持的正确位置
items.note: 11:04，原因是它们处理的数据都得进入区块，现实中就是 calldata。
items.title_en: Vitalik: precompiles and the EVM are both the wrong place to put most cryptography support
items.note_en: 11:04, because the data they operate on has to be included in the chain, which realistically means block calldata.

keywords_en: cryptography does not belong in precompiles
summary_en: Pierre and winderica ported Tornado Cash to Flock, a post-quantum binary-field SNARK, proving a depth-32 withdrawal over SHA-256 in under 30 ms, and described a recovery protocol that lets existing pools survive a discrete log break. Vitalik argued that precompiles and the EVM are the wrong place for most cryptography support, because their data has to go into blocks as calldata. EIP-8288 proposes moving the recursive STARK into the execution payload, and tcoratger submitted a post-quantum validator key registry.
